name: t2d_bottomline_mouse_msigdb
description: T2D seed-replication sweep on the real bottom-line GWAS streamed from S3 (dig-open-bottom-line-analysis, Mixed/T2D.sumstats.tsv.gz, 8.3 GB gz). Reproduces the command that dock/pigean-validation.workflow.yaml runs for model=mouse_msigdb under the dock_current param set: --update-hyper none, --sigma-power 0, --max-num-gene-sets 5000, and the per-library p-noninf priors from dock/config/models.yaml (mouse_2024 0.0015, msigdb_nohp 0.0075). The only thing the sweep changes is the seed.
